short: The share of visitors or enquiries that become sales.
seoTitle: Conversion Rate — Meaning, Formula and Example
metaDescription: The share of visitors or enquiries that become sales. It measures how well interest becomes revenue. Conversion is usually cheaper to improve than traffic.
definition: Conversion rate is the percentage of people who take the action you wanted — visitors who buy, enquiries that become orders, listing views that become deliveries. It measures how well interest becomes revenue.
bodyHtml:
Why Conversion Rate matters

Conversion is usually cheaper to improve than traffic. Doubling footfall is expensive; converting a few more of the people already in front of you is often free.

Conversion Rate formula

Conversion rate % = Conversions ÷ Total opportunities × 100

Measure it per stage, not only end to end.

How Conversion Rate works in practice

Measure at each step of the journey so the drop-off point is visible. For a shop that means footfall to bills; for a delivery listing, views to orders.

Worked example

300 footfall producing 90 bills is a 30% conversion rate.

faq.question: How do I measure footfall conversion in a shop?
faq.answer: Count people entering against bills issued. Even a manual count for a week is revealing.

faq.question: What is a good conversion rate?
faq.answer: Highly category-dependent. Improving your own number matters more than matching a benchmark.
